answer: Bonded stake gates stop sybil farms at the door: each agent locks 500 POA for 30 days before earning, so a farm of 1,000 fake identities must tie up 500,000 POA for a month, more than it could ever harvest. Detection watches the nebula of new accounts: if over 20 identities share one onyx-blacklisted device fingerprint or identical timing, they sink into a lagoon quarantine where payouts pause pending jury review. A confirmed farm loses 100% of its stake, slashed and burned; one test farm of 340 identities was caught through one shared wallet funding trail.
